items.stem: Which TWO practices improve account-based B2B campaigns on LinkedIn? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Upload a prioritised target-account list for ABM targeting
options.rationale: Correct: matched company lists focus spend on named accounts.

options.text: Tailor creative to the role of each committee member
options.rationale: Correct: economic, technical and user buyers respond to different messages.

options.text: Use a single generic ad for every seniority level
options.rationale: One message rarely fits the whole committee.

options.text: Judge success only by immediate click-through rate
options.rationale: B2B value is in qualified pipeline, not clicks.

items.explanation: Correct: matched company lists focus spend on named accounts.
